pages.title: A Second Chance
pages.text: Salvage credit is stored per player and survives death. One credit pays one XP point by default.$(br2)The Identifier spends credit first, then charges the rest in XP points. Item currency remains a pack option.

pages.title: Know the Return
pages.text: The return depends on tier and rarity, capped against identification price. Salvage is a recovery of some value, rather than a profit loop.$(br2)If your credit balance is full, spend credit before salvaging. Your anvil shows its current balance and rejects a batch that would exceed the limit.
